invariants.statement: Capability never grants authority
Approval canonical task/action bindings cannot be rewritten during consumption
Kernel approval resume preserves the same Task, Step and FEET route and a consumed Approval cannot replay
Unknown external effect never permits blind unsafe retry
Task completion requires an IMMUNE-owned verified completion manifest
Production source cannot create new direct Evidence, completion-manifest, ledger-write, or legacy callable readback truth paths outside canonical owners
Registered provider execution fails closed unless it reaches the governed registered-provider dispatch boundary; no raw supervisor execute fallback is allowed
Verified terminal completion closes Task, Step, and FEET route consistently
VOICE never upgrades tool/effect success into verified completion
Retrieved memory never silently becomes current truth
A Context Manifest reference has immutable meaning; changed context requires a new manifest identity and cannot silently replace an already-bound Task or Assignment context
Recovery reconstructs next work without replaying external commands
A dependency-ready continuation must receive a fresh IMMUNE authority verdict before assignment claim or Task EXECUTING state; expired or revoked grants fail closed

After process restart, a persisted POSSIBLE or UNKNOWN external effect must be independently observed and reconciled under a fresh fenced lease; recovery never steals a live lease or replays the external command
Runtime readiness percentages are derived from canonical evidence-bearing state and 100 percent requires consistent VERIFIED completion
Repository readiness selectors establish declared source coverage only; they never by themselves prove test execution, external-system acceptance, or BRO production readiness
Changes reaching main must be associated with a merged pull request; direct main delivery fails closed
Protected architecture changes are delivered as declared subsystem remediation waves; micro-fixes require an explicit emergency reason
Multi-step plans preserve canonical Step dependencies and only dependency-satisfied Steps become READY
A multi-step business outcome advances dependency-ready Steps on one canonical Task and only completes after all required evidence is VERIFIED
Only IMMUNE-verifier-minted VALID CURRENT evidence from the exact Task boundary may become a CONFIRMED Observation that automatically supersedes unfinished Steps and creates a new MIND Plan revision
A replanned Step must belong to the current Plan revision and receive a fresh IMMUNE authority verdict before assignment claim or Task EXECUTING state
HANDS-owned Artifact runtime revisions are immutable and VERIFIED requires sufficient IMMUNE Evidence from the same task boundary
Authenticated external writes require exact current IMMUNE authority and provider-declared mediated secrets; registration alone grants neither
Unknown GitHub write outcomes reconcile against the provider-owned external marker before retry, and VERIFIED completion requires independent registered readback plus trusted Evidence
